subject: google/dreambooth/monster_toy
resize: shortest side then center crop, bicubic

prompts.train_00: A photo of sks monster toy sitting on an indoor windowsill, with a city visible outside.
prompts.train_01: A photo of sks monster toy sitting on an office desk in front of a computer monitor.
prompts.train_02: A photo of sks monster toy sitting on a sunlit windowsill, seen from a slight side angle.
prompts.train_03: A photo of sks monster toy sitting on the hood of a car outdoors.
prompts.heldout_04: A photo of sks monster toy sitting on a stone surface beside green plants.
prompts.short_beach: A photo of sks monster toy sitting on a sandy beach beside a small blue bucket, full body visible.

proposed_training.target_modules: same 98 projections quantized in official NVFP4 checkpoint in both modes

identity: two stalk eyes and yellow hair
red nose and two white fangs
four red rope limbs with white ends
quality_rubric.memorization: no direct reuse of training backgrounds; heldout scenes
quality_rubric.preservation: generic cat and different monster prompts stay responsive
quality_rubric.base_gate: inspect short AND detailed prompt outputs; change subject before training if identity is already reliable

caveats: Only four training photographs and one heldout photograph: not a broad statistical benchmark.
